artifacts: full raw definitions and original control clocks
explicit failed trial state/control/time and traceback
supervisor resource stop and result receipts
execution_policy: Root-only future one-role commands under existing run_bounded supervisor; aggregate jobs detached/durable if expected>=10min; no automatic polling or dependent followup launch
input_policy: qualified recipe/ramps/all controls/8us horizons/resource and shape caps frozen; change execution.dt only
observer_boolean_policy: exact equality; every mismatch exceeds the fixed comparison threshold
observer_comparison: all qualified observer-map channels evaluated in separate production-only projection roles at independent standard/tight oracle states; independent field/source/work/invariant checks remain separate; no new all-formula independent-observer claim

oracle.method: DOP853 segmented at original control boundaries; bath evaluated at every internal state clock, ordinary experiment controls held at segment-left
oracle.process_independence: separate oracle process imports no Cells/JAX; uses independent full-node/scalar actual-pool equations
oracle.samples: full finest accepted grid, all original observer clocks and complete conservation at every accepted sample

production.field_sampling: right-continuous controls at exact accepted observation boundaries
production.invariant_checks: original parent production and independent molecular/capacitor/ER/fuel/source/work budgets at every accepted point
production.method: existing classical rk4_step with full-domain checked RHS witness at all4stages and accepted endpoint checks

qualification_receipts: required immutable ordinary and epoch source receipts; pending Root qualification

refinement.common_times: all coarse accepted times with exact membership in middle/fine grids
refinement.criterion: If both successive differences are <=1% of accuracy budget, report accuracy below refinement resolution with no observed-order claim; otherwise require decreasing successive differences and observed order>=3
refinement.failure: No shortening durations, moving controls, loosening tolerances or automatically adding further levels

resources.cpu: explicit Root-selected affinity required at future execution

scope: synthetic full scheduled-bath temporal coupling: ordinary SIM8us and independent actual INIT8us->SIM8us calcium/fuel; no native/biology/performance claim
source_policy: each production resolution and independent tolerance carries its own complete actual full8us INIT endpoint; reset only clock; no fresh pools
streaming: production full-state and every observer row saved in storage-capped overlapping8-step chunks; preserve complete accepted grids on disk
